opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not give their own name or greet the caller, so the opening criterion is not met.

verification.quote: Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
verification.comment: The agent asked for name and order number, and the caller gave name and order 804257 before any order data was discussed, so verification was done.

understanding.quote: Agent: Okay, Ahmed. Order 804257, a lamp at €44.50, in transit for 12 working days. So nothing at all has arrived?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue accurately, confirmed the missing delivery, and did not re-ask for information already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Right. I've opened a lost parcel investigation. It closes within 5 working daze and then we send a replacement 3 walking days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent stated the investigation and replacement timelines correctly, but the policy requires 10 working days before an investigation opens and the call was at 12 days, so that is acceptable; the replacement timing of 3 working days is correct, though the agent said 'walking days' which is a transcription or wording error to correct.

process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission and did not thank the caller on return, which the policy requires.

communication.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling Tidewell. Goodbye.
communication.comment: The caller said they were absolutely furious and the agent never acknowledged that frustration, so the communication criterion is not met.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an e-mail when the investigation closes. Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step and asked if anything else was needed before closing politely, which meets the closing criterion.
